title: Office Receptionist
description:
Temporary Office Receptionist

16.41 per hour Monday-Friday Free onsite parking

We are looking for a Temporary Office Receptionist to provide front-of-house and facilities support for our client in Maryhill, Glasgow for 5 weeks. You must be available to start on the 14th September and cover until the 16th October.

Hours
- Monday-Thursday: 8:30am-5:00pm
- Friday: 8:30am-2:00pm
- 16.41 per hour

Duties

title: Receptionist
description:
Exciting Receptionist Opportunity in Glasgow!

Our client is seeking a dedicated and personable Receptionist to join their team on-site in Glasgow. This is a fantastic opportunity for an individual with a passion for providing exceptional customer service while supporting workplace operations!

Position Details:
- Pay: 17 - 19 per hour (PAYE)
- Start Date:Wednesday, 30th September 2026 (pending security clearance)
- Duration:Until Friday, 30th October 2026
- Hours:Monday to Friday, 36 hours per week
- Location:Fully onsite in Glasgow

Key Responsibilities:

Workplace Operations:
- Support the smooth day-to-day operation of the workplace, ensuring efficient service delivery.
- Conduct regular inspections to identify and coordinate solutions for workplace issues.
- Maintain a safe and welcoming office environment.

Front of House and Customer Service:
- Serve as the primary on-site contact for colleagues, visitors, and contractors.
- Provide a professional front-of-house service that enhances the visitor experience.
- Manage visitor access arrangements and respond promptly to inquiries.

Facilities and Supplier Coordination:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with landlords, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
- Monitor workplace issues and ensure timely resolution to minimise disruption.

Operational Support and Administration:
- Maintain accurate workplace records and support administrative processes.
- Coordinate services including post handling and hospitality supplies.

Essential Criteria:
- Experience in delivering outstanding customer service in a reception, office coordination, or similar environment.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build effective relationships.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and Excel.

This role offers a dynamic environment where you can shine and contribute to the success of the organisation. If you are a proactive individual with a knack for multitasking, this is the role for you!

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply today for this exciting opportunity to make a difference in a vibrant workplace!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
Data & Administration Coordinator

Salary: 25,500 per annum Full-time 37.5 hours per week

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Data & Administration Coordinator to join our team and provide administrative support across two busy teams.

This is a varied role, ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, is confident using Excel and can manage a high volume of work accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:
- Completing accurate data entry and maintaining records.
- Entering timesheets into timesheet system.
- Completing portal entries and ensuring information is kept up to date.
- Running and reconciling reports, investigating and resolving discrepancies where required.
- Checking and approving portal shifts.
- Raising invoices accurately and within required timescales.
- Providing general administrative support across both teams.
- Supporting with ad-hoc tasks as required.

We are looking for someone who:
- Has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in producing accurate work.
- Is confident using Excel and working with data.
- Can manage large volumes of information without losing accuracy.
- Is organised and able to prioritise competing deadlines.
- Can work at a fast pace and remain calm under pressure.
- Has a proactive and flexible approach.
- Is happy to support across different areas of the business.
- Has good communication skills and enjoys working as part of a team.

Previous experience in an administrative, data entry, finance or similar role would be advantageous, but the right attitude, accuracy and willingness to learn are just as important.

The weekly hours would be 37.5 but the client can be flexible with start and end times, the start of the week is the busiest so they could do long days for an earlier finish on a Friday or even some Sunday hours if the successful candidate would like (not essential though).

If this sounds like an opportunity you would be interested in, then please apply now or email me on (url removed)

title: Administrator - (Higher Education) Immediate Start
description:
Teaching Administrative Assistant

Location: Glasgow
Rate: 14.18 per hour
Start Date: Tuesday, 15 September 2026
End Date: 9 October 2026
Hours: Full-time (1 FTE)

About the Role:

We are looking for an organised and proactive Teaching Administrative Assistant to provide administrative support to the Undergraduate Medical School. This is a varied administrative role involving communication with academic and clinical staff, students, GP practices and external contributors. The successful candidate will help coordinate teaching, assessments, tutor activities and course administration, ensuring everything runs smoothly and to schedule.

Key Responsibilities:
- Provide administrative support for the organisation and delivery of General Practice clinical placement teaching and assessments.
- Assist with the delivery and coordination of GP teaching and clinical placements.
- Maintain accurate records relating to payments to GP practices and course contributors.
- Liaise with course coordinators, tutors, students and relevant medical school staff.
- Provide administrative support for Communication Skills sessions.
- Prepare, edit, copy and collate course documentation, handbooks and teaching materials.
- Distribute information and materials to tutors and students using electronic systems and bulk mailing platforms.
- Assist with the planning and delivery of the annual GP Tutor Training Conference and other tutor training events.
- Regularly update teaching content on online platforms such as Moodle.
- Support the set-up and administration of OSCE assessments both on and off campus.
- Handle enquiries from students, staff and external contacts, escalating more complex queries where appropriate.
- Maintain accurate administrative records and handle confidential information with tact and discretion.
- Undertake other reasonable administrative duties as required by the management team.

About You:

The ideal candidate will have previous administrative experience and be confident working in a busy environment where accuracy, organisation and communication are essential.

You will ideally have:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise workloads and work to deadlines.
- A proactive approach, with the ability to use initiative and work independently.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a wider team.
- Excellent IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office.
- Experience handling large volumes of administrative data, records and information.
- Experience handling confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of people.

Previous experience within Higher Education, medical education, teaching administration or a similar environment would be advantageous, as would experience with financial administration, bespoke IT systems, Moodle or web editing.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Start date: 02.11.2026

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Claims Handler (FTC)
description:
Claims Handler (12-Month FTC)

Glasgow £37.4k - £39.2k per annum (dependent on skills and qualifications)

Full-time

Joint-contribution pension from 6% (12% total) - Enhanced maternity & family leave - Life assurance - HolidayPlus - Virtual GP & Employee Assistance Programme plus retail and leisure discounts & many more.

REQ5995

At SGN, we rely on effective claims management to ensure claims are investigated, managed and resolved fairly, efficiently and in line with company policies and regulatory requirements. As a Claims Handler, you'll be responsible for managing public liability and/or recovery claims, providing a high-quality service.

We deliver safety, warmth, and comfort to homes and businesses. Every role, whether in the office or on the front line, plays a key part in this mission. Here's how you will contribute
- Receive, record, and acknowledge new claims, reviewing for completeness and coverage.
- Investigate, negotiate, settle, and maintain accurate records of claims, managing own caseload and escalating as needed.
- Work with legal support to resolve disputes.
- Authorise and approve claims in line with policies and legal frameworks (NSRWA 1991, Gas Act 1986).
- Follow best practices, adhere to policies and legal frameworks, and stay updated with relevant Case Law.
- Respond to inquiries about the claims/recovery process, providing clear and timely information.
- Provide excellent customer service, offering regular updates and promptly resolving issues.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and customers.
- Handle MoJ Portal Claims.
- Identify and pursue recovery opportunities, maximising recovery items and maintaining accurate records.
- Prepare reports on claim status and recovery performance, tracking KPIs.
- Identity and raise risks, issues, or exceptions related to claims/recovery analysis.
- Support the development of the claims management team and documentation.
- Identify opportunities to streamline processes and drive efficiencies.

What you will need
- Understanding of insurance principles, products and claims processes.
- Experience handling claims, including exposure to both defendant and claimant litigation.
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Proven ability to influence, challenge and negotiate, using sound judgement to achieve positive outcomes
